title: Vibrant Spanish Garlic Arroz Negro
description: A sour, crispy, and quick-fix Spanish dish featuring garlic, mantecare, and a satvik twist. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Arroz Negro (Squid Ink Rice)
ingredients.notes: Available at most Spanish or Asian grocery stores.

ingredients.name: Smoked Paprika
ingredients.notes: Spanish smoked paprika (pimentón) for added depth.

ingredients.name: Champagne Vinegar
ingredients.notes: White wine vinegar or apple cider vinegar as substitute.

instructions: Heat EVOO in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add crushed garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute.
Add Arroz Negro and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add mantecare, lemon juice, smoked paprika, salt, and crushed red pepper flakes. Stir until the mixture is heated through and slightly thickened.
Add chopped parsley if using. Stir to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Transfer the arroz negro to a serving dish and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
